offers_products.reason: Main offering is coating work on customers' own steel; Precoat coils are processed for customers, not sold goods.

offers_services.reason: Hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating are toll processing services done on customer-owned fabricated steel and coils.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are fabricators, manufacturers, contractors, utilities and infrastructure owners, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Galvanizing serves steel fabricators, OEMs, highway and utility projects; Precoat serves building product and appliance manufacturers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Fabricators and manufacturers repeatedly send steel and coil for coating; high-volume repeat orders, though project-linked.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand follows construction, infrastructure and manufacturing activity, which customers can delay or cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Coating jobs are small, frequent processing orders per customer, a minor part of fabrication cost.

people_delivered.reason: Service depends on galvanizing kettles, coil coating lines and plants, not mainly on staff skill time.

large_customers.reason: Many customers are mid-size fabricators and manufacturers, though Precoat serves some large manufacturers; mixed customer base.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates network of galvanizing plants with zinc kettles and coil coating lines needing continual capital investment.

notes: Large-customer answer is uncertain; customers mix fabricators and large manufacturers.
